annotations.title: Create a seller listing: sell your HTTPS endpoint per call

description: Creates a seller listing: your HTTPS endpoint sold per call at the price you set, callable by anyone as tool run_<slug> or POST /v1/run/<slug>; each sale is credited to you minus the platform fee. Posting your own slug again appends a new version. Use it to sell your own API or agent through gaents. Use catalogue instead to see existing listings first. Use seller_statement instead to see your sales and payable earnings. Cost: free; nothing is charged to list. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST /v1/accounts gives one). Errors (isError, error.code): 400 bad_slug/bad_price/bad_upstream_url/kind_not_open, 401 bad_api_key, 409 slug_taken (another seller owns it).

description.description: What the endpoint does, for buyers and agents choosing a tool.
examples: Returns a 5-sentence summary of the page at url.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema of the body your endpoint takes (shown to buyers as the tool's inputSchema).

listed.description: false hides the listing from the catalogue and tools/list; default true.

price_usd.description: Your price per call in USD; the buyer pays this, you receive it minus the platform fee.

slug.description: Listing id in the URL: lowercase letters, digits and '-', 2-63 characters.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for your endpoint per call (capped by the server's own limit).

title.description: Short name buyers see in the catalogue and tools/list.

upstream_url.description: Your endpoint; each sale POSTs the buyer's JSON body to it and returns its answer.

name: listing_create

platform_fee.description: share of each sale kept by the platform
